name: Pushwoosh
description: Pushwoosh is a customer-engagement platform for mobile and web push notifications, in-app messages, email, SMS, journeys, segmentation, analytics, and experimentation. Product and marketing teams use it to coordinate messaging and measure audience engagement across applications.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-generated Pushwoosh Server API token and bind one exact application code; agents can read a fixed 24-hour window of aggregate enabled/disabled subscriber counts through one read-only statistics endpoint.

credentialRequirements.name: PUSHWOOSH_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Pushwoosh Server API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a dedicated revocable Server API token for the required project. Relay encrypts it and sends it only as an Authorization: Key header to the fixed Pushwoosh API origin.

credentialRequirements.name: PUSHWOOSH_APPLICATION_CODE
credentialRequirements.label: Pushwoosh application code
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the exact 5-5 application code, such as XXXXX-XXXXX. Relay binds every request to this application.

capabilities.label: Read subscriber-status summaries
capabilities.description: Read at most 100 hourly platform aggregates of push-enabled and push-disabled subscribers for the last 24 completed hours.

approvalRequired.label: Get Pushwoosh subscriber-status summary
approvalRequired.description: Return at most 100 timestamp/platform aggregate enabled and disabled counts from the last 24 completed hours for the bound application.

blocked.label: Access users, devices, tags, or events
blocked.description: Device tokens, HWIDs, user IDs, emails, phone numbers, aliases, tags, attributes, locations, events, subscriptions, and individual histories remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access messages, content, or detailed analytics
blocked.description: Campaign names, message content, targeting, segments, filters, templates, journeys, experiments, recipients, outcomes, reports, and detailed analytics remain blocked.

blocked.label: Send, write, or administer Pushwoosh
blocked.description: Push, email, SMS, and in-app sends; application, user, device, tag, segment, template, campaign, token, webhook, and project changes; and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API or bulk access
blocked.description: Device API tokens, arbitrary applications, origins, paths, methods, headers, queries, bodies, time windows, pagination, retries, raw responses, SDKs, browser sessions, bulk, and exports remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded aggregate subscriber-status read requires approval; identities, content, detailed analytics, sends, writes, administration, arbitrary APIs, and bulk remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bounded aggregate read runs directly; exact application binding, fixed endpoint/window, redaction, caps, audits, and provider authorization remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives one fixed Pushwoosh application-subscriber-statistics wrapper with identity and content exclusion.
Hermes receives the same fixed Pushwoosh application-subscriber-statistics wrapper with identity and content exclusion.

providerSetup.blocker: Pushwoosh Server API access requires an eligible customer project, an exact application code, and a customer-generated token authorized for that project.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer admin generates a dedicated revocable Server API token for the required project, supplies the exact application code, and completes a live read-only statistics check.

evidence.supports: Pushwoosh documents customer-generated Server API tokens, project assignment, Authorization: Key authentication, and separate device-token authority.

Pushwoosh documents POST /api/v2/statistics/application/getSubscribersStatistics with application_code and UTC timestamp bounds, returning timestamp/platform enabled and disabled subscriber aggregates.
Pushwoosh documents the application code as the identifier used in API requests and shows the XXXXX-XXXXX form.
Pushwoosh documents a broad messaging, audience, statistics, and project API surface; Relay mounts only the fixed aggregate statistics read.

securityNotes: The Server API token and application code are encrypted as secret references; the token is sent only as an Authorization: Key header to https://api.pushwoosh.com.

Relay allowlists only POST /api/v2/statistics/application/getSubscribersStatistics with the bound application code and the last 24 completed UTC hours, rejects redirects, waits at most 30 seconds, and caps responses at 1 MB.

The result contains at most 100 valid timestamp/platform aggregates and non-negative enabled/disabled counts; device tokens, users, tags, events, message content, targeting, recipients, and detailed outcomes are excluded.
Sends, writes, project/application changes, administration, arbitrary APIs, runtime parameters, pagination, retries, SDKs, browser sessions, bulk, and exports remain blocked.
Provider 401/403/404/429 and server errors are surfaced safely; token creation/capture, project assignment, provider-console work, and live acceptance remain customer/external steps.
